title: The Siege of Chittor
historical_context: Chittor was the principal stronghold of Mewar and came under siege by Mughal forces led by Akbar in late 1567.
The defence of the fort is associated with commanders including Jaimal Rathore and Patta Chundawat after Udai Singh II withdrew from the final defence.
Mughal siege operations included covered approaches (sabats) and mining/siege engineering.
The fort fell to Mughal forces in February 1568 after a prolonged siege.

decision_points.prompt: The siege works are advancing. What should the defenders prioritize?

options.title: Concentrate Defenders
options.description: Commit more defenders to the most threatened approaches.

options.title: Reinforce Sectors
options.description: Strengthen threatened positions while preserving more of the garrison.

options.title: Limited Sortie
options.description: Attempt a focused counteraction against nearby siege activity.

options.title: Conserve Strength
options.description: Accept slower pressure now to preserve the garrison for later turns.

decision_points.prompt: A major defensive sector is under severe pressure. How do you respond?

options.title: Concentrate at Breach
options.description: Commit remaining strength to the most threatened defensive point.

options.title: Redistribute Defenders
options.description: Spread the remaining force across several critical positions.

options.title: Counterattack Siege Works
options.description: Attempt another direct disruption of the siege operation.

options.title: Preserve Remaining Strength
options.description: Reduce immediate losses even if the fort's position worsens.

canonical_timeline.title: Mughal siege begins
canonical_timeline.description: Akbar leads the Mughal campaign against Chittor and the fort comes under siege.

canonical_timeline.title: Siege works advance
canonical_timeline.description: Accounts describe covered approaches and mining/siege engineering used against the fort.

canonical_timeline.title: Jaimal is killed
canonical_timeline.description: Abu'l Fazl and Badayuni describe Jaimal being shot during the final stage of the siege; the V&A Akbarnama manuscript also depicts this episode.

canonical_timeline.title: Chittor falls
canonical_timeline.description: The fort is captured by Mughal forces after the prolonged siege.
